gate: Compile/no-run/discovery and any candidate publication execution require separate review of the fixed test head and manifest. No Rust execution at source/static stage.
scope: Only the new tests/rust-file-publication tree and its synthetic runs. No retained snapshot paths modified. Local raw logs/binary only; no independent transfer.
preflight: Hold the current room's blocking exclusive flock during every shared build/cache/fixture/log mutation, re-read git status and pinned inputs inside the lock.
Verify 10 fixed production files, source manifest, test manifest and all deliverables. Pin head, bytes, SHA256, Git blob/mode, environment allowlist and existing toolchain versions.
Refuse a preexisting nonempty runs path, any symlink/path escape, wrong owner/mode or unknown supported-filesystem status. Fresh run ID and exclusive artifact directory; no reuse after failure.
Use installed 1.99.1-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu and existing libc cache, no install/network/fallback. CARGO_NET_OFFLINE=true, dedicated target below this test root.
Linux ef53/ext-family or XFS magic is a prerequisite only. The first real test may still fail on O_TMPFILE/linkat/fsync; preserve and stop.
order: Locked/offline cargo test --no-run for exactly the single explicit test target.
Extract the unique executable artifact from cargo JSON; require its path below the dedicated target and record SHA256.
Run --list --format terse once. Validate every nonempty line, unique exact names and complete set of 54.
Run each sorted name exactly once with --exact NAME --test-threads=1 --nocapture. Each success must have exactly one expected name and 1 passed/0 failed/0 ignored/0 measured/53 filtered.

After each child: collect wait exit and pipe EOF, rehash frozen inputs and binary, inspect runs without following links or reading special files. Stop on nonzero, unknown result, mismatch, residue or cap.
Keep raw logs, exact names/classes and source-before/after/binary hashes. Do not rerun or change expectations after first failure.
enforcement: Use a parent command supervisor with bounded streaming stdout/stderr, elapsed deadlines and retained prefix on overflow. On failure signal only the harness-owned child/process group, record termination and bounded reap separately. Never assert that timeout interrupts uninterruptible I/O. Logical synthetic sizes can be monitored but are not a filesystem quota.
cleanup: All Rust assertions precede Sandbox::finish. Successful case directories removed explicitly; empty runs owner root and evidence/target retained. No cleanup on failed assertions/panic. On interruption or timeout preserve remaining paths; do not remove uncertain/replaced paths. join follows bounded response receipt; external process limit bounds observation if join does not return.
unsupported: Fail/stop, not ignore, mock success or weaker fallback. No security/permission changes, mounts, proc substitution, launcher or Windows/VM operations.
